title: Fix the Division Bug
instructions:
This program is supposed to calculate the average score from 3 qualification matches, but it's printing `26` instead of `26.666666666666668`. Fix the bug so it produces the correct decimal result.

Hint: Integer division drops the decimal part!
hint: Convert one of the values to Double before dividing. You can use .toDouble() on the numerator.
starterCode:
fun main() {
    val match1 = 30
    val match2 = 25
    val match3 = 25
    val total = match1 + match2 + match3

    val average = total / 3
    println(average)
}
solutionCode:
fun main() {
    val match1 = 30
    val match2 = 25
    val match3 = 25
    val total = match1 + match2 + match3

    val average = total.toDouble() / 3
    println(average)
}
